short_answer: For invoices and quotes as PDFs, sent from your own email, probably not. Xero's entry plan, Ignite, caps you at 20 invoices a month, and it is an accounting service: worth paying for if you need bank reconciliation, payment tracking, reports or to share the books with an accountant. The free generator here has no monthly limit, saved templates with automatic numbering, extra columns and a real PDF to email.
paywall:
Xero sells invoicing as part of its accounting plans. On Ignite, its entry plan, Xero says: "For more than 20 invoices, see the Grow plan", and the limit covers both approving and sending invoices. See the current Australian plans for prices. Other invoice apps draw the line in similar places: Invoice Home's free plan stops at $1,000 invoiced in 30 days, and Invoice Ninja's free plan at 5 clients (each on its own pricing page, October 2026).

This tool makes the document, the PDF and the email for free, with no limit; it does not replace a bookkeeping system.
free_does:
• Creates invoices and quotes in AUD, with business, customer, ABN and date fields, and up to two extra columns on each line (Date, Hours, Job no., SKU).
  • Supports no GST, GST exclusive and GST inclusive pricing, and taxable or no GST lines.
  • Calculates quantities, line totals, GST and outstanding amounts using integer arithmetic.
  • Downloads a real PDF directly, or prints through your browser.
  • Emails it through your own mail app: the PDF is attached for you where your device can share files, otherwise it downloads alongside a ready written message.
  • Saves templates in your browser with your business details, terms and columns, and numbers the next invoice for you. No account, no uploads, no monthly limit.

ABN checks validate format and checksum only. You choose the correct GST registration and line item treatment for your business.
when_pay: Consider accounting software if you need automatic bank feeds, reconciliation, recurring invoices sent on a schedule, customer payment links, automatic reminders, business reports or shared records. This generator does not send email from its own server, collect payments, lodge tax returns, maintain a ledger or back up your documents. Keep your PDFs, and export your templates if you change browsers.
